description: This file defines the CsvDataImportFactory class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for creating instances of data import classes based on the import type. It includes a single method getImportClassInstance which returns a PimCsvDataImport instance when the import type is 'pim'.

classes.name: CsvDataImportFactory
classes.description: A factory class to generate data import class instances based on import type.

methods.name: getImportClassInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of PimCsvDataImport if the import type is 'pim'.
